Practical workshops for growing product teams

Northstar Learning Studio runs facilitated workshops for product managers, designers, and engineers who want to improve cross-functional decision making.

What teams practice

Each workshop combines short lessons, realistic planning exercises, and guided reflection. Sessions focus on product discovery, prioritization, and clear written decisions.

Designed for working teams

Programs are designed for established teams and can be delivered as a focused half-day workshop or a multi-session learning series.

How the program works

Facilitators tailor examples to the participating team while keeping the curriculum centered on repeatable methods that participants can use in their weekly work.

Organizations can request a program outline through the inquiry form on this page.
